blocks.text: From June to October the number of houses listed in Sperling-Duthie fell from 31 to 24 (−22.6%); 14 sold in that time. In October, Sperling-Duthie had 5.6% of Burnaby’s 430 listed houses.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is almost entirely detached houses: post-war bungalows on the west side, and large custom and estate homes in the Buckingham Heights pocket on the slope east of Deer Lake.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Woodward House, at 5195 Sperling Avenue and built in 1912, is on the City's heritage register, so heritage rules can touch a purchase on that street.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Burnaby City Hall, at 4949 Canada Way, sits just west of the sub-area at Deer Lake, so civic business is inside the neighbourhood's orbit.
The Bill Copeland Sports Centre, at 3676 Kensington Avenue, is the area's arena, with a National Hockey League-size rink seating 1,984.
The 1912 Woodward House at 5195 Sperling Avenue is the heritage-register anchor on the spine itself, not a museum elsewhere in the city.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: getting around

items.t: Sperling–Burnaby Lake Station, on the Millennium Line, stands at Sperling Avenue and Lougheed Highway at the area's north end, and Sperling Avenue runs south from it to Deer Lake Park.
Canada Way crosses the area and Burnaby City Hall sits on it at 4949 Canada Way, just west of the sub-area.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the heritage register before buying on Sperling Avenue itself, since Woodward House at 5195 Sperling Avenue is a registered heritage property.

blocks.text: How Sperling-Duthie compares with nearby areas

For houses, Sperling-Duthie sits at $1,850,250, above 1 of the 5 nearby areas that can be compared. The highest of them is Deer Lake at $2,900,000, and the lowest Burnaby Lake at $1,825,000.
For duplexes, Sperling-Duthie sits at $1,774,000, above all 4 nearby areas that can be compared. The highest of them is Burnaby Hospital at $1,695,000, and the lowest Forest Glen at $1,504,000.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 24 houses listed in Sperling-Duthie. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sperling-Duthie a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: Sperling-Duthie houses sold at a sales ratio of 17% in October 2026, a balanced market on the reports’ scale (under 12% favours buyers, over 20% favours sellers).

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sperling-Duthie from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Which schools serve Sperling Avenue addresses?
faq.a: École Sperling Elementary, at 2200 Sperling Avenue, is the School District No. 41 (SD41) elementary school on the spine, and the SD41 school locator lists 2200 Sperling Avenue as Sperling Elementary for Kindergarten to Grade 7 and Burnaby North Secondary for Grades 8 to 12, not Burnaby Central Secondary; confirm the assigned schools for a specific address before relying on them.

faq.q: What is happening at Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: Burnaby Hospital, at 3935 Kincaid Street, is being redeveloped in phases: Phase 1 is a six-storey 83-bed pavilion, and Phase 2 is a 160-bed acute care tower with a cancer centre, with Phase 2 dates still to be determined.

faq.q: What did houses in Sperling-Duthie sell for?
faq.a: 20 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $1,850,250.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 35 days. At the median, sale prices were 94.5% of list, and 0% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
